description: Start the user's session sandbox (isolated cloud shell — the safe place to test untrusted tools; sandbox_exec runs work inside it). SPENDS the daily run allowance: 1 run, or 3 with `browser: true` (a chromium-capable sandbox) — confirm with the user before calling unless they just asked for one. Idempotent: an already-running sandbox is returned (`existing: true`), never doubled. Needs `wallet_address`; anon works. 429 = today's allowance is spent (resets tomorrow; logging in raises it).

browser.description: true = a browser-capable (chromium) sandbox — costs 3 runs instead of 1

name: sandbox_start
title: Sandbox Start
